properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 12 at 5:10PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 510 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a line of strong
thunderstorms extending from 7 miles southwest of Willard to near
Elba, or extending from 20 miles northeast of Fort Morgan to 15 miles
south of Akron, moving northeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and half inch size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Akron, Otis, Merino, Hillrose, Midway, Platner, Prewitt Reservoir,
Elba, Atwood, Fremont Butte, Messex and Union.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued August 12 at 5:09PM MDT until August 12 at 8:00PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban areas and small streams flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is occurring. Reports of mudslide on Interstate 70 near
Dowds Junction.

* WHERE...East Central Eagle County in west central Colorado, along
Interstate 70 from mile marker 165 to 175...

* WHEN...Until 800 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding over roadways and Interstate 70 is imminent or
occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 506 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Flooding is ongoing in the warned area. Between
0.5 and 1 inch of rain has fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Avon, Vail, Minturn, Edwards, Eagle-Vail and Dowd.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 12 at 5:08PM MDT until August 12 at 5:45PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
SVRBOU

The National Weather Service in Denver has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northwestern Logan County in northeastern Colorado...
Northeastern Weld County in northeastern Colorado...

* Until 545 PM MDT.

* At 508 PM MDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
10 miles northwest of Westplains to 7 miles southeast of Pawnee
Buttes, or along a line from 33 miles northwest of Sterling to 36
miles north of Fort Morgan, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Golf ball size hail and 60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...People and animals outdoors will be injured. Expect hail
damage to roofs, siding, windows, and vehicles. Expect
wind damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Westplains.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 12 at 4:57PM MDT until August 12 at 5:30PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 12 at 4:36PM MDT until August 12 at 6:00PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding and debris flows are possible, flooding
caused by excessive rainfall continues.

* WHERE...Gold Mountain burn scar in Ouray County, Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 600 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Storms producing excessive rainfall are developing
upstream and near the Gold Mountain Burn Scar. Excessive rain is
possible and could lead to flash flooding and/or debris flows,
particularly along highway 550 between Cutler Creek and Dexter
Creek.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 436 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in Cutler and Dexter Creek drainages.
- Cutler and Dexter Creek drainages is the most likely place to
experience minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Dexter and Cutler Creek and nearby areas along Highway 550
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 12 at 4:27PM MDT until August 12 at 6:30PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Mudslide and flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Garfield County in west central Colorado,
between Carbondale and Glenwood Springs, along Highway 82...

* WHEN...Until 630 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying, poor drainage areas and
water over roadways expected. Highway 82 is susceptible to
rockfalls and mudslides in heavy rainfall.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 424 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.3 and 0.8 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Glenwood Springs and Cattle Creek.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 12 at 3:24PM MDT until August 12 at 6:30PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
FFWPUB

The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Willow Burn Scar in...
Central Lake County in central Colorado...

* Until 630 PM MDT.

* At 324 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Willow Burn Scar. The expected rainfall rate is
0.5 to 1 inch in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1
inch are possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly. Excessive rainfall over the burn scar
will result in debris flow moving through the Rock Creek, WIllow
Creek, Rock Creek Trail and near the Leadville National Fish
Hatchery. The debris flow can consist of rock, mud, vegetation and
other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Willow Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Willow Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Turquoise Lake.
